command:
# G2 #22 absolute big-RAM baselines (docs/g2.md; scripts/g2/ram2.plan): upstream kraken2 at the
# pin (pristine; built from source here) on RODA v205 on a 1536 GiB node, default load (table
# resident) from instance-store NVMe (RAID0 over the six devices), n = 3 per cell: host default,
# an uninstrumented control, THP never vs always, and THP always + numactl --interleave=all;
# then a perf record of the load. Reads: SRR062634 8M-pair prefix, checked against its sha256
# and SOURCE. The database is checked against the RODA object's ETag. Every setup step fails fast.
W=$HOME/ak2; mkdir -p "$W"
SHA=${AK2_RUN_ID##*-}
B=aws-kraken2-942542972736-us-west-2; DATA=aws-kraken2/data
fail() { ak2_say "ERROR: $*"; exit 1; }
G2_DEADLINE=$(( $(date +%s) + 100 * 60 )); export G2_DEADLINE

ak2_phase setup
sudo -n dnf install -y -q git > "$W/dnf0.log" 2>&1 || fail "dnf git failed"
git clone -q https://github.com/scttfrdmn/aws-kraken2.git "$W/repo" || fail "clone failed"
git -C "$W/repo" checkout -q "$SHA" || fail "checkout $SHA failed"
cd "$W/repo" || fail "no repo"
. scripts/g2-instance.sh
g2i_setup
g2i_nvme

ak2_phase fetch-reads
RD=$G2_NVME/reads
g2i_stage_reads "$RD" "$B" "$DATA" SRR062634_8000000

ak2_phase fetch-db
( g2i_build > "$W/build.out" 2>&1 ) &
BUILD_PID=$!
g2i_awscfg 50Gb/s
DB=$G2_NVME/db/RefSeqCompleteV205
g2i_stage_roda "$DB"
wait "$BUILD_PID" || { cat "$W/build.out"; fail "build failed"; }
cat "$W/build.out"
G2_UPSTREAM=$(scripts/oracle-build.sh) || fail "upstream build not found"
export G2_UPSTREAM

G2_PLAN=scripts/g2/ram2.plan G2_DB=$DB G2_READS=$RD G2_WORK=$G2_NVME/work G2_LABEL=ram2 G2_RUNG_TIMEOUT=1200
export G2_PLAN G2_DB G2_READS G2_WORK G2_LABEL G2_RUNG_TIMEOUT
. scripts/g2.sh
RC=$?
ak2_say "g2 ram2 rc=$RC"
ak2_phase push
[ "$RC" = 0 ] || exit "$RC"
exit 0
